explanation: Push incoming values onto one stack. Dequeue from a second stack, transferring all incoming values only when that second stack is empty; the transfer puts the oldest value on top. The operation adapter recreates both stacks on each Queue constructor command and validates every recorded dequeue. Unknown commands are rejected.
timeComplexity: O(1) amortized time per enqueue/dequeue; a single transfer can take O(n).
spaceComplexity: O(n) retained values for n live queued items.
